description: The Cooper Companies, Inc., headquartered in San Ramon, California, is a leading global medical device company focused on helping people experience life's beautiful moments, selling products in over 130 countries and positively impacting over fifty million lives each year. It operates through two business segments, CooperVision and CooperSurgical, which elevate standards of care with products and services in the fields of vision, fertility and women's health. CooperVision is a global manufacturer providing products for contact lens wearers, developing, manufacturing and marketing a broad range of single-use, two-week and monthly contact lenses featuring advanced materials and optics to address vision challenges such as astigmatism, presbyopia and myopia with spherical, toric and multifocal lenses, and it also manufactures and markets myopia management products.
